audit.whatIsWrong: Text framed the lane as generic 'ranged mage bullies melee' without naming which of Mel's tools actually creates the difficulty.
audit.why: Mel's Radiant Volley (Q) reaches 950 and Solar Snare (E) reaches 1000 against Kassadin's 650 Q and 400 E — the difficulty is a range gap plus a root, not vague poke.
audit.corrected: Early is Mel's on range (950/1000 vs 650/400) and on Solar Snare's root; the lane flips at 6 when Riftwalk gives Kassadin a 500-range blink he can repeat.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with itself across layers: phases[2..5].side read 'Skill' while win[2..5] read Mel/Mel/Mel/Kassadin, and win[4] said Mel while whys[4] said the lane flips to Kassadin at 6.
audit.why: Riftwalk at 6 is the documented flip; both layers must state the same row.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Mel, Mel, Mel, Mel, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin across both layers, with whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Null Sphere (Q) is a projectile and Rebuttal (W) reflects projectiles back at the caster; and Null Sphere is a channel that Solar Snare's root cancels.
audit.why: Both are stated in Riot's own text — Rebuttal 'reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker', Null Sphere is flagged channel/projectile.
audit.corrected: Never fire Null Sphere into a glowing Rebuttal; and do not start the Q while her Solar Snare is up — the root cancels it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no cooldown number at all.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38s at rank 1 and still 26s at rank 5; Solar Snare 11s down to 9s; Golden Eclipse 120/100/80.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] claimed Mel uses Golden Eclipse 'to punish any Kassadin approach attempt'.
audit.why: Golden Eclipse is a 120/100/80s global that detonates Overwhelm stacks — it is not an anti-engage button. Solar Snare and Rebuttal are.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Solar Snare into Rebuttal.

audit.why: 60.69% over 809 games matches the scaling verdict.
